headline: Tavernier and Manzambi are mid
body: I don't get why there's such a rush to get them in. Most people already own some combination of Groß, Palmer, Rogers, Mbeumo, Cherki. Tavernier and Manzambi are not much better or worse picks than any of them. And there are other options like MGW, KDH, Gakpo who look just as viable. They are fine for the price, and obviously they might do really well because a lot comes down to luck, but nothing screams that they are the second coming of 23/24 Palmer. Feels like both Tav and Manzambi are just the flavours of the week.   submitted by   /u/superlord354 [link]   [comments]
